$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/integration.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). Outside services are called only by apps/factory-api's gateway, in an office session or in the system context of the worker and scheduler (office role factory_runtime, RLS forced); floor and portal/link sessions never reach these tables (their work that needs a provider runs as a job). IntegrationCall is append-only (`@append-only`, scripts/factory/check-append-only.mjs): no update or delete grant, and the triggers of the …_integration_guards migration refuse UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE for every login. InboundWebhook is never deleted and its receipt columns never change (the same migration's guard trigger); only its processing state moves. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

IntegrationAccount.about: Office admins keep the accounts (through command()); the gateway reads an account before each call and records its last success and failure; the inbound route reads it (as the tenant's system context) to verify a webhook. Disabled, never deleted.

SecretValue.about: Sealed secrets: written when an admin saves credentials, read (and opened in memory) by the gateway and the inbound route, re-sealed in place by a rotation, deleted when the credential is replaced or its account removed. Only the wrapped data key and the ciphertext are stored.

IntegrationCall.about: The gateway adds one row per call; the Connections page and the error queue read them. Nobody changes or removes a row.

InboundWebhook.about: The inbound route (the tenant's system context) adds the receipt; the worker's job reads it and moves its processing state (status, attempts, processedAt, lastError; the trigger refuses any other change). Never deleted.
